editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat: the security warnings ("**تجنّب تنفيذ الكود على جهاز غير موثوق**", "فأبطل مفتاحك فورًا"), the "44-character" key, "ساعة على الأكثر" for "no more than one hour", and "لن يكون الرمز المميز مرئيًا مرة أخرى" all land correctly, and the informal register (كنت، مفتاحك، غيّر، جرّب) holds with no formal slips. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "المصادقة إلى" is a direct calque of "authenticate to" and appears three times (both H2 headings plus "للمصادقة إلى Qiskit Runtime REST API"); Arabic convention is "المصادقة على" / "المصادقة لدى". (2) "instance" is rendered "النسخة" (line ~26), which reads as "copy/version"; the established cloud term is "مثيل". (3) Two stiff "لـ + brand" possessives — "لوحة التحكم لـ IBM Quantum Platform" (line ~51) — where the natural idāfa "لوحة تحكم IBM Quantum Platform" is what a native writer would produce; "الرمز المميز المكتسب" for "the acquired token" is likewise unidiomatic. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Optional: Find the instance you want to use from the Instances page. … so you can use it to identify the instance.

examples.why: In cloud/IBM Cloud context "instance" is conventionally مثيل; نسخة reads as "copy" or "version" and is the weaker, more literal choice. Recognizable in context, so MINOR — but an editor would swap it.

examples.source: …the 44-character API key you created and saved from your IBM Quantum Platform dashboard. … After the acquired token expires…
examples.suggested: …الذي أنشأته وحفظته من لوحة تحكم IBM Quantum Platform. … بعد انتهاء صلاحية الرمز المميز الذي حصلت عليه…

examples.why: "لوحة التحكم لـ X" avoids the natural idāfa construction and reads mechanically; "المكتسب" is an odd participle for a token you simply obtained/received. Both are fluent-MT tells rather than native technical writing.

editor_note: The modular-arithmetic section is broken in a way that misleads: "modular exponentiation" is rendered "الرفع الأسي المعياري" (= *standard* exponentiation — and this same file uses معياري for "standard" everywhere else: "الخوارزمية المعيارية", "الأساس القياسي"), and the crux sentence "perform the entire computation modulo M" becomes "لإجراء الحساب كله بالتلافي مع $M$" ("by avoiding/averting M"), which is not Arabic for "modulo" and destroys the very reason the power algorithm stays cheap (it looks like a corruption of "بالتوافق مع M"). The lesson's closing sentence is also dropped entirely — EN ends "All of the circuit families we'll discuss do have this property — but this is nevertheless an important issue to be aware of…", while the Arabic stops after the definition of التوحيد, so the reassurance and the caveat both vanish. Smaller drift: "polynomial-cost algorithms with large exponents" becomes "بمعاملات كبيرة" (large *coefficients*). On top of that, three <Figure> blocks (multiplication, division, modular exponentiation) are left wholly in English although the addition Figure was translated, and core terms split within the file: elementary operations = العمليات الأولية / العمليات الأساسية, unitary = أحادية (line ~110, reads as "unary") / وحدانية (line ~125), quantum computing = كمومية / كمية, and the heading "الترميز التقريبي" ("approximate notation") contradicts the body's own تقاربياً for asymptotic.

examples.source: modular exponentiation
examples.suggested: الرفع الأسي بالمقياس / الأُسّ النمطي (modular exponentiation)
examples.translation: الرفع الأسي المعياري
examples.why: الملف نفسه يستخدم «معياري» بمعنى standard («الخوارزمية المعيارية»)، فيقرأ العنوان كـ«الرفع الأسي القياسي» ويضيع مفهوم mod M — تضارب مصطلحي يولّد اعتقادًا خاطئًا.

examples.source: All of the circuit families we'll discuss do have this property — but this is nevertheless an important issue to be aware of in general when studying circuit models of computation from a formal viewpoint.
examples.suggested: وجميع عائلات الدوائر التي سنناقشها تتمتع بهذه الخاصية — لكنها تبقى مسألة مهمة ينبغي الانتباه إليها عمومًا عند دراسة نماذج الدوائر الحسابية من وجهة نظر رسمية.
examples.translation: (محذوفة بالكامل — النص العربي ينتهي عند تعريف خاصية التوحيد)
examples.why: حذف جملة الختام يُسقط طمأنة المتعلم بأن دوائر الدورة منتظمة، ويترك القيد معلّقًا دون حسم.

examples.source: polynomial-cost algorithms with large exponents can sometimes be improved dramatically
examples.suggested: يمكن أحيانًا تحسين الخوارزميات ذات التكلفة متعددة الحدود ذات الأُسس الكبيرة تحسينًا جذريًا
examples.translation: يمكن أحيانًا تحسين الخوارزميات ذات التكلفة متعددة الحدود بمعاملات كبيرة بشكل كبير
examples.why: «معاملات» = coefficients لا exponents؛ الفقرة السابقة تتحدث عن $n^{1000}$ أي الأُسّ، فينقلب المقصود، مع تكرار ركيك («بمعاملات كبيرة بشكل كبير»).

examples.source: elementary operations
examples.suggested: توحيد المصطلح على «العمليات الأولية» في الملف كله
examples.translation: العمليات الأولية … العمليات الأساسية
examples.why: المصطلح المحوري للدرس يظهر بصيغتين متبادلتين؛ وكذلك unitary بين «أحادية» (تُقرأ unary) و«وحدانية»، و«الحوسبة الكمومية/الكمية».

examples.source: <Figure title="Integer multiplication"> Input: integers N and M / Output: NM
examples.suggested: <Figure title="ضرب الأعداد الصحيحة"> المدخلات: … / المخرجات: …
examples.translation: بقيت الكتل الثلاث بالإنجليزية كما هي رغم ترجمة كتلة «جمع الأعداد الصحيحة»
examples.why: عدم اتساق داخلي واضح: تعريفات المسائل الثلاث (الضرب، القسمة، الرفع الأسي) غير مترجمة بينما نظيرتها الأولى مترجمة.

editor_note: The body is faithful — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, no hallucinated sentences; the dry-run, validation and AQC-target/ansatz paragraphs all track the English, and informal 2nd-person singular (يمكنك، اكتب، ابدأ، استخدم) holds throughout. What a native editor would change: (1) the opening sentence renders "time evolution … against a … Hamiltonian" as "التطور الزمني لحالة ابتدائية مقارنةً بهاميلتونيان" ("compared to a Hamiltonian"), which muddles the physical relation — evolution is generated *under* the Hamiltonian, so "تحت تأثير هاميلتونيان" / "بموجب هاميلتونيان" is needed. (2) "two-qubit depth" is rendered three different ways, one of them malformed: "عمق البوابتين الكيوبتيتين" (dual: "the two qubit gates") appears twice, versus the correct-sense "عمق البوابات الثنائية Qubit" later — the standard "عمق البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت" should be used everywhere. (3) Smaller slips: "observable" splits between "المؤثر/المؤثرات" (which also carries "operators" in the same paragraph) and "مؤثر رصد"; "domain-level" splits between "على مستوى المجال" and "المستوى التطبيقي"; "tensor network" becomes "الشبكات الترابطية" (recognizable only thanks to the English gloss); "بيك‌اند" for backend contains a Persian zero-width non-joiner (U+200C) and is not idiomatic Arabic; and two feminine-agreement errors ("يُنشأ دائرة هدف"، "يُنشأ نسخة من EstimatorV2") plus the calque "ما وراء الإعدادات الافتراضية" read as MT rather than native technical prose.

examples.source: This template encapsulates a workflow to simulate the time evolution of an initial state against a user defined spin-based Hamiltonian
examples.suggested: … لمحاكاة التطور الزمني لحالة ابتدائية تحت تأثير هاميلتونيان قائم على السبين يُعرّفه المستخدم
examples.translation: يُغلّف هذا القالب سير عمل لمحاكاة التطور الزمني لحالة ابتدائية مقارنةً بهاميلتونيان قائم على السبين يُعرّفه المستخدم
examples.why: "against a Hamiltonian" here means evolution generated *under* that Hamiltonian; "مقارنةً بـ" says "in comparison with", which misstates the Hamiltonian's role in the very first sentence that defines what the template does.

examples.source: the two-qubit depth of the final instruction set architecture (ISA) circuit
examples.suggested: عمق البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت لدائرة ISA النهائية (in all three places)
examples.translation: عمق البوابتين الكيوبتيتين لدائرة بنية مجموعة التعليمات (ISA) النهائية  …  [later, line 538] عمق البوابات الثنائية Qubit لدائرة ISA النهائية
examples.why: "البوابتين الكيوبتيتين" is a dual form meaning "the two qubit gates" — it counts two specific gates instead of naming gates that act on two qubits — and the file then uses a third, better rendering later, so the metric is named inconsistently.

examples.source: a set of observables to estimate expectation values … quantum circuits and operators … an initial state and observable
examples.suggested: use one rendering for observable throughout (e.g. المؤثر القابل للرصد / مؤثر الرصد) and reserve المؤثرات for "operators"
examples.translation: ومجموعة من المؤثرات لتقدير قيم التوقع … الدوائر الكمومية والمؤثرات … وحالة ابتدائية ومؤثر رصد
examples.why: "observables" and "operators" collapse onto the same word المؤثرات two paragraphs apart, then observable switches to مؤثر رصد near the end; a reader cannot tell which of the two distinct concepts is meant in the input list.

examples.source: The generated circuits from the AQC addon are then transpiled to execute on a chosen backend.
examples.suggested: … لتُنفَّذ على backend مختار.
examples.translation: تُحوَّل الدوائر المولَّدة من إضافة AQC بعد ذلك عبر الـ transpilation لتُنفَّذ على بيك‌اند مختار.
examples.why: "بيك‌اند" is an ad-hoc transliteration containing a Persian zero-width non-joiner (U+200C), which is not Arabic typography; the file keeps other tool terms (transpilation, ansatz, QPU, Estimator) in Latin script, so backend should follow the same convention.

examples.source: A target circuit is created … An EstimatorV2 instance is created … beyond the defaults that are part of this example
examples.suggested: تُنشأ دائرة هدف … تُنشأ نسخة من EstimatorV2 … بما يتجاوز الإعدادات الافتراضية …
examples.translation: يُنشأ دائرة هدف … يُنشأ نسخة من EstimatorV2 … ما وراء الإعدادات الافتراضية المضمّنة في هذا المثال
examples.why: دائرة and نسخة are feminine, so the masculine passive يُنشأ is a straight agreement error a native technical writer would never produce, and "ما وراء" is a literal calque of "beyond" in the quantitative sense.

editor_note: The substance is faithful throughout — the delicate passages all land correctly: the garbage/uncompute argument (تنظيف القمامة، عكس R), the invertibility caveat "فهي ليست أحادية حين لا تكون f قابلة للعكس", the "*نستبدل* x بـf(x)" contrast with the XOR query gate, and the "ليس اختصاراً لعكس الدوال حسابياً" caveat are all intact, and the g-for-garbage wordplay is handled well. Three things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The opening sentence adds an invented, meaningless gloss: "بتكلفة حسابية مقاربة مقاساً بالتدرج التبايني" — "التدرج التبايني" (differential gradation) corresponds to nothing in "similar asymptotic computational cost" and merely confuses; "مقاربة" alone already carries "asymptotic". (2) "controlled-NOT" is rendered throughout as "بوابات NOT المضبوطة" — "مضبوط" means adjusted/calibrated, not controlled; the conventional term is "المتحكَّم بها" / "المشروطة", and it degenerates into "بوابات NOT مضبوطة مضبوطة" for controlled-controlled-NOT. It is at least used consistently and sits next to CNOT/figures, so it stays recognizable. (3) A few calqued/agreement slips: "على أسفل $m$ كيوبتاً" (twice) for "on the bottom m qubits", "تبقى الكيوبتان العليا" (should be العلويان), and "تُحصلان بصورة مستقلة". Also the qualifier "arbitrary" is dropped from "arbitrary functions having binary string inputs and outputs". None of these mislead.

examples.source: any computation that can be performed with a classical Boolean circuit can also be performed by a quantum circuit with a similar asymptotic computational cost.
examples.suggested: ... بدائرة كمومية بتكلفة حسابية تقاربية مماثلة.
examples.translation: سنرى أن أي حوسبة يمكن تنفيذها بدائرة كلاسيكية بوليانية يمكن أيضاً تنفيذها بدائرة كمومية بتكلفة حسابية مقاربة مقاساً بالتدرج التبايني.
examples.why: 'مقاساً بالتدرج التبايني' (measured by differential gradation) is an invented gloss with no counterpart in the source and no meaning in complexity theory; 'مقاربة/تقاربية' already renders 'asymptotic'. It does not overturn the claim, but it is fluent text asserting a measure the English never mentions.

examples.source: controlled-NOT gates ... controlled-controlled-NOT gates
examples.suggested: بوابات NOT المتحكَّم بها (CNOT) ... بوابات NOT مزدوجة التحكم
examples.translation: بوابات NOT المضبوطة ... بوابات NOT مضبوطة مضبوطة
examples.why: 'مضبوط' means adjusted/calibrated, not controlled; the standard Arabic domain rendering is 'المتحكَّم بها' or 'المشروطة'. Used consistently and adjacent to CNOT and the figures, so the concept remains identifiable — imperfect but recognizable, hence minor.

examples.source: the resulting value f(x) will appear on the bottom m qubits — or we can feed in a different state to the bottom m qubits
examples.suggested: وستظهر القيمة الناتجة $f(x)$ على الكيوبتات $m$ السفلية — أو يمكننا تغذية الكيوبتات $m$ السفلية بحالة مختلفة
examples.translation: وستظهر القيمة الناتجة $f(x)$ على أسفل $m$ كيوبتاً — أو يمكننا تغذية حالة مختلفة إلى أسفل $m$ كيوبتاً
examples.why: 'على أسفل m كيوبتاً' is a word-order calque of English 'the bottom m qubits' that no Arabic technical writer would produce; the noun-adjective form 'الكيوبتات السفلية' is the natural phrasing. Meaning survives, style does not.

examples.source: unitary query gate implementations of arbitrary functions having binary string inputs and outputs
examples.suggested: لتطبيقات بوابات الاستعلام الأحادية لدوال اعتباطية ذات مدخلات ومخرجات من السلاسل الثنائية
examples.translation: لتطبيقات بوابات الاستعلام الأحادية للدوال ذات المدخلات والمخرجات الثنائية
examples.why: Drops 'arbitrary' and 'string'. The generality of the pattern (it holds for any such function, not just some) is the point of the sentence; losing the qualifier weakens the claim slightly without inverting it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveat, no hallucination: the optimization_level 0-vs-3 contrast, the "same setting may help one circuit and hinder another" warning, the "shorter circuits should give better results" chain, and the Hellinger parenthetical (القيمة الأعلى أفضل، والقيمة 1 تعني دقة مثالية) all match the English exactly, and register is consistently informal singular (يمكنك / نتائجك / أنشئ). Three editorial slips remain: (a) "qubits decohere over time" is rendered تتفكك qubits بمرور الوقت, where تفكك means "disintegrate/fall apart" rather than فقدان الترابط/التماسك الكمومي — recognizable but imprecise; (b) "two-qubit operations/gates" becomes عمليات الـ Qubitين / بوابات الـ Qubitين, an Arabic dual suffix grafted onto an English stem that no native technical writer would produce (بوابات ثنائية الكيوبت is the natural form); (c) "transpiler" is المُحوِّل in all body prose but switches back to English in the Next-steps links (مرحلة Transpiler مخصصة, and the calqued والـ Transpile إليها). Also minor: البدائي Sampler for "the Sampler primitive" reads oddly as a noun. None of these would lead a learner to a false belief.

examples.source: Since multi-qubit gates have high error rates and qubits decohere over time, the shorter circuits should give better results.
examples.suggested: ... وتفقد الكيوبتات ترابطها الكمومي بمرور الوقت ...
examples.translation: بما أن بوابات متعددة الـ qubit لها معدلات خطأ مرتفعة وتتفكك qubits بمرور الوقت، فإن الدوائر الأقصر ينبغي أن تعطي نتائج أفضل.
examples.why: تتفكك literally means 'disintegrate/come apart'; decoherence is loss of quantum coherence (فقدان الترابط/التماسك), not physical disintegration. Recognizable from context, so imprecise rather than misleading.

examples.source: adds swap gates to allow all two-qubit operations / prints the number of two-qubit gates
examples.suggested: ... للسماح بجميع العمليات ثنائية الكيوبت / عدد البوابات ثنائية الكيوبت
examples.translation: ويضيف بوابات التبديل للسماح بجميع عمليات الـ Qubitين / وتطبع عدد بوابات الـ Qubitين
examples.why: The Arabic dual ending is attached to an English stem (الـ Qubitين), producing a hybrid form a native technical writer would never use; ثنائية الكيوبت is the idiomatic construction.

examples.source: Write a custom transpiler pass / Create and transpile against custom backends
examples.suggested: كتابة مرحلة مُحوِّل مخصصة / إنشاء واجهات خلفية مخصصة والتحويل إليها
examples.translation: كتابة مرحلة Transpiler مخصصة / إنشاء Backends مخصصة والـ Transpile إليها
examples.why: The body consistently uses المُحوِّل for transpiler, but the Next-steps links revert to English, and والـ Transpile إليها is a code-switched calque (Arabic definite article + English verb) that reads as raw MT in an otherwise clean file.

examples.source: run these circuits using the Sampler primitive and store the results to `result`
examples.suggested: ... باستخدام أولية Sampler ...
examples.translation: شغِّل هذه الدوائر باستخدام البدائي Sampler وخزِّن النتائج في `result`
examples.why: البدائي as a standalone noun carries the everyday sense 'primitive/backward'; Qiskit primitives are conventionally أوليات/بدائيات in Arabic technical prose. Defensible but stiff.

editor_note: The prose is faithful and mostly natural — the fermionic/bosonic mapping paragraph, the Jordan-Wigner passages, the ZZII qubit-ordering explanation ("الكيوبت 0 في أقصى اليمين") and the informal singular register ("بصفتك متخصصاً"، "ضع في اعتبارك"، "تأمّل حالة الإيثين") all hold; no hallucination, no dropped caveat, no swapped quantity. The main defects are terminological: "irreducible representation" is rendered "تمثيل اختزالي" (line ~396), which drops the negation and literally reads "reducible/reductive representation" — the correct form is "تمثيل غير قابل للاختزال"; it is only rescued because the adjacent PySCF output literally prints "irrep". Also "unitary" → "أحادية" (line ~183) reads as "unary/single" rather than the conventional "وحدوية", "spin" in the step list → "الدوران" (rotation, line ~45) instead of "السبين"، and "active space" is split between "الفضاء النشط" (lines ~45, 503) and "فضاء النشاط الكامل" (lines ~165–167). A few grammar/agreement slips remain ("جزيئتك" for جزيئك، "في فضاءك النشط" for فضائك، "يقوم كتلة الكود" for تقوم، "حين تساور الشك" missing its object pronoun، "أساس دنيا").

examples.source: Among other useful information, this returns both `point group symmetry = Coov` and also the number of orbitals in each irreducible representation.
examples.suggested: ... وأيضاً عدد المدارات في كل تمثيل غير قابل للاختزال (irrep).
examples.translation: من بين المعلومات المفيدة الأخرى، يُعطي هذا `point group symmetry = Coov` وأيضاً عدد المدارات في كل تمثيل اختزالي.
examples.why: "اختزالي" means reductive/reducible — the negation in "irreducible" is dropped, so the Arabic term states the opposite of the group-theory concept. Recognizable only because the code output next to it prints "irrep", which is why this is minor rather than fatal, but it is the highest-value fix in the file.

examples.source: The result of such a mapping is conventionally written in terms of Pauli operators, since they are both Hermitian and unitary.
examples.suggested: ... لكونها إيرميتية ووحدوية في آنٍ واحد.
examples.translation: عادةً ما تُكتب نتيجة هذا التعيين بدلالة عوامل باولي، لكونها إيرميتية وأحادية في آنٍ واحد.
examples.why: "أحادية" is ambiguous with "unary/single-fold"; the established Arabic term for a unitary operator is "وحدوي". A learner could read this as "one-dimensional" rather than U†U = I.

examples.source: 1. Define your molecule (geometry, spin, active space, and so on)
examples.suggested: 1. تعريف جزيئك (الهندسة الفراغية، والسبين، والفضاء النشط، وغير ذلك)
examples.translation: 1. تعريف جزيئتك (الهندسة الفراغية، والدوران، والفضاء النشط، وغيره)
examples.why: "الدوران" is the word for rotation; electron spin is conventionally "السبين" (or "اللف المغزلي") in Arabic physics/chemistry writing — especially here where the later `__spin__` bullet defines it as the number of unpaired electrons (2S), not any rotation. Also "جزيئتك" is the wrong form of جُزَيء (masculine) → "جزيئك".

examples.source: __ncas__: number of orbitals in the complete active space / __nelecas__: number of electrons in the complete active space
examples.suggested: عدد المدارات في الفضاء النشط الكامل / عدد الإلكترونات في الفضاء النشط الكامل
examples.translation: __ncas__: عدد المدارات في فضاء النشاط الكامل / __nelecas__: عدد الإلكترونات في فضاء النشاط الكامل
examples.why: "active space" is rendered "الفضاء النشط" everywhere else in the file (lines ~45، 406، 503، 518) but becomes "فضاء النشاط" here, splitting the CAS terminology within a single page.

examples.source: This is in contrast to Hamiltonians used in Qiskit, which would write the term `[Z2 Z3]` as `ZZII` ...
examples.suggested: وهذا على النقيض من الهاميلتونيات المستخدمة في Qiskit، التي تكتب الحد `[Z2 Z3]` كـ `ZZII` ...
examples.translation: هذا يتعارض مع الهاميلتونيات المستخدمة في Qiskit، التي تكتب الحد `[Z2 Z3]` كـ `ZZII` ...
examples.why: "يتعارض مع" means "conflicts/contradicts", which overstates a neutral notational contrast; the English only says the two conventions differ. Minor strengthening of the claim, not a meaning error.

editor_note: Faithful overall — every benchmark number, release date, trained-on-Qiskit version, model name, CLI flag and installation step matches the source, and the informal singular register (جهازك، طرفيتك، ثبِّت، اتّبع) holds throughout with no inversions, swapped quantities or hallucinated claims. The main defect is a false friend: "Python commits" is rendered التزامات Python ("Python commitments/obligations"), from which no Arabic reader recovers the git-commit sense — it should be كوميتات/عمليات إيداع Python or kept in English. Second, "parameterized circuit" becomes دائرة مُعامَلة, which parses as "treated circuit" rather than the conventional دائرة ذات معاملات / دائرة مُعلَّمة. Smaller slips: the intensifier in "much more challenging" is dropped (أكثر تحديًا without بكثير); "ideal for quick experimentation **and** for users that want fewer technical details" is merged into a single restricted audience (مثالي للتجريب السريع للمستخدمين الذين...); "Our LLMs" flattens to نماذجنا الكبيرة, losing the "language" component; "ran them on the models" is agent-inverted to وأجرينا عليهما اختبارات النماذج; and تضمن التثبيت المُقيَّد has a gender disagreement (should be يضمن).

examples.source: fine-tuning it on high-quality Qiskit data, as well as Python commits and chat
examples.suggested: ... فضلًا عن كوميتات (commits) Python والمحادثات
examples.translation: وضبطه الدقيق على بيانات Qiskit عالية الجودة، فضلًا عن التزامات Python والمحادثات
examples.why: التزامات means "commitments/obligations". The git-commit sense is unrecoverable; the reader is left with a meaningless training-data category.

examples.source: How do I create a parameterized circuit in Qiskit?
examples.suggested: كيف أُنشئ دائرة ذات معاملات في Qiskit؟
examples.translation: كيف أُنشئ دائرة مُعامَلة في Qiskit؟
examples.why: مُعامَلة is the passive participle of عامَل ("treated/handled"), not of معامل ("parameter"); the standard domain rendering is دائرة ذات معاملات.

examples.source: This change makes the dataset much more challenging for LLMs
examples.suggested: يجعل هذا التغيير مجموعة البيانات أكثر تحديًا بكثير لنماذج LLM
examples.translation: يجعل هذا التغيير مجموعة البيانات أكثر تحديًا لنماذج LLM
examples.why: The intensifier "much" is dropped, softening the claim about how much harder QHE Hard is.

examples.source: It's ideal for quick experimentation and for users that want fewer technical details to handle.
examples.suggested: وهو مثالي للتجريب السريع وللمستخدمين الذين يريدون التعامل مع تفاصيل تقنية أقل.
examples.translation: وهو مثالي للتجريب السريع للمستخدمين الذين يريدون التعامل مع تفاصيل تقنية أقل.
examples.why: Missing conjunction turns two independent use cases into one, narrowing "ideal for quick experimentation" to only that user group.

examples.source: The "jupyter-ai<3" pin ensures you get v2.x.
examples.suggested: يضمن التثبيت المُقيَّد "jupyter-ai<3" الحصول على الإصدار v2.x.
examples.translation: تضمن التثبيت المُقيَّد "jupyter-ai<3" الحصول على الإصدار v2.x.
examples.why: Gender disagreement: التثبيت is masculine, so the verb should be يضمن.

examples.source: ...to create the execution-based benchmarks called Qiskit HumanEval (QHE) and Qiskit HumanEval Hard (QHE Hard), and ran them on the models.
examples.suggested: ...ثم شغّلناهما على النماذج
examples.translation: ...وأجرينا عليهما اختبارات النماذج
examples.why: Agent/patient inverted: the English runs the benchmarks on the models, the Arabic runs "the models' tests" on the benchmarks. Stiff and backwards, though the gist survives.

editor_note: The lesson's central term "arbitrary" is rendered throughout as "عشوائي" (= random/stochastic), not "اعتباطي/كيفي": the thesis sentence becomes "القدرة على تصحيح أخطاء X وأخطاء Z أو كليهما تستلزم القدرة على تصحيح الأخطاء العشوائية" — i.e. "implies the ability to correct RANDOM errors" — and the section heading "Arbitrary qubit errors" becomes "أخطاء الكيوبت العشوائية", with "arbitrary qubit channel Φ" becoming "قناة كيوبت عشوائية" (a randomly-drawn channel). This softens/narrows the theorem to exactly the misconception the lesson exists to dispel (the English stresses errors "not necessarily close to the identity"), and it collides head-on with the same word used for genuine randomness a few lines later ("متلازمة خطأ عشوائية", "هكذا تتم إزالة العشوائية — أو الإنتروبيا"), so the reader cannot tell the two concepts apart. Secondary defects: "dephasing" → "تخفيت" (muting/dimming, the phase notion is gone) and "depolarizing" → "تخفيف قطبي"; "tensor products" → "ضربات تنسورية" (lit. "tensorial blows") and the tensoring step at line 36 flattened to plain multiplication "نضرب المصفوفة الأحادية في مصفوفة المتطابقة"; "errors that are revealed" inverted to the active participle "الأخطاء الكاشفة" (the revealing errors); plus recurring grammar slips ("خطأ يوصفه بمصفوفة باولي", "خطأ يوصفه قناة كيوبت", "عمليات اكتشاف الخطأ تُنهار الحالة", "منخفضات" for subscripts, "أي مصفوفة أحادية 2×2 للقيمة U").

examples.source: the ability to correct X errors, Z errors, or both, implies the ability to correct arbitrary errors … an error described by an arbitrary qubit channel Φ
examples.suggested: … تستلزم القدرة على تصحيح الأخطاء الاعتباطية (أي خطأ كان) … خطأ تصفه قناة كيوبت اعتباطية $\Phi$
examples.translation: فالقدرة على تصحيح أخطاء $X$ وأخطاء $Z$ أو كليهما تستلزم القدرة على تصحيح الأخطاء العشوائية … خطأ يوصفه قناة كيوبت عشوائية $\Phi$
examples.why: 'عشوائي' means random/stochastic, not arbitrary. The learner takes away that the code corrects RANDOM errors, missing the actual claim that ANY error (including tiny coherent/systematic ones) is corrected — the very point of the section. Worse, the same word is used correctly for real randomness later ('متلازمة خطأ عشوائية', 'إزالة العشوائية — أو الإنتروبيا'), leaving the two distinct concepts indistinguishable.

examples.source: this could be a dephasing or depolarizing channel, a reset channel
examples.suggested: قد تكون هذه قناة فقدان الطور (dephasing) أو قناة إزالة الاستقطاب (depolarizing)، أو قناة إعادة ضبط
examples.translation: قد تكون هذه قناة تخفيت (dephasing) أو تخفيف قطبي (depolarizing)، أو قناة إعادة ضبط
examples.why: 'تخفيت' means muting/dimming and drops the phase concept entirely; 'تخفيف قطبي' reads as 'polar dilution' rather than loss of polarization. The parenthetical English partly rescues them, but the Arabic itself teaches nothing about what these channels do.

examples.source: If we now compute and measure the error syndrome, and correct for any errors that are revealed
examples.suggested: إذا حسبنا متلازمة الخطأ وقسناها وصحّحنا أي أخطاء تُكشف
examples.translation: إذا حسبنا متلازمة الخطأ وقسناها وصحّحنا الأخطاء الكاشفة
examples.why: Active participle 'الكاشفة' means 'the errors that reveal', inverting the voice of the English 'errors that are revealed' (المكشوفة). It breaks the causal chain the sentence is teaching: the syndrome reveals the errors, not the other way round.

examples.source: errors on multiple qubits can be expressed as tensor products of Pauli matrices … we tensor the unitary matrix with the identity matrix on every other qubit
examples.suggested: … كـ *حواصل ضرب تنسورية (tensor products)* … نضرب المصفوفة الوحدوية ضربًا تنسوريًا في مصفوفة المتطابقة على كل كيوبت آخر
examples.translation: يمكن التعبير عن الأخطاء على كيوبتات متعددة كـ *ضربات تنسورية (tensor products)* … نضرب المصفوفة الأحادية في مصفوفة المتطابقة لكل كيوبت آخر
examples.why: 'ضربات' is the plural of 'a blow/strike', not of a product; the conventional term is 'حواصل الضرب التنسوري' or 'الجداءات التنسورية'. At line 36 the tensoring is flattened to ordinary multiplication, dropping the operation the sentence is defining.

examples.source: we effectively project the error onto an error that's described by a Pauli matrix … the error detections collapse the state
examples.suggested: نُسقط فعليًا الخطأ على خطأ يوصَف بمصفوفة باولي … عمليات اكتشاف الخطأ تُسبب انهيار الحالة
examples.translation: نُسقط فعليًا الخطأ على خطأ يوصفه بمصفوفة باولي … عمليات اكتشاف الخطأ تُنهار الحالة
examples.why: 'يوصفه' carries a spurious object pronoun (twice, plus a gender mismatch with 'قناة'), and 'تُنهار' is not a valid transitive form of انهار. Together with 'منخفضات' for subscripts and 'أي مصفوفة أحادية 2×2 للقيمة U', the prose reads as unrevised machine output rather than an Arabic technical writer's.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every prose sentence tracks the English (counts, caveats, the "you could use the base primitives instead" note, and the Next-steps list all match), and the informal register (استخدم / يمكنك / تدرَّب) holds throughout. Four editorial defects: (1) the broken article artifact "الـ دائرة" appears twice (lines ~143 and ~235) — Arabic already carries the definite article in دائرة, so "الـ دائرة" reads as a mechanical find-replace leftover where a native writer would write "الدائرة"; (2) "circuit" is rendered three ways in the same file — "Circuit-مراقِب" (line 43), "دائرة-مراقِب" (line 87) and "Circuits" in the heading (line 141); (3) "quantum operators" in the intro becomes "المعاملات الكمية" (line 39), which reads as coefficients/parameters and collides with "معاملات" used for *parameters* two sections later ("قيم المعاملات", "Circuits ذات معاملات"), so the same word carries two different concepts; (4) "observable" is rendered as the active participle "مراقِب" (= observer/monitor) rather than a passive/observable form — recognizable in context from the SparsePauliOp code, and consistent within the file, but the corpus elsewhere prefers "مؤثر". None of these would make a learner believe something false, so this stays MINOR.

examples.source: leveraging parameter values to increase circuit reusability / to optimize circuit performance on QPUs
examples.suggested: لزيادة إمكانية إعادة استخدام الدائرة … لتحسين أداء الدائرة
examples.translation: لزيادة إمكانية إعادة استخدام الـ دائرة … لتحسين أداء الـ دائرة
examples.why: "الـ" prefixed to an already-definite Arabic noun is a doubled article — a visible find-replace artifact no native technical writer would produce.

examples.source: expectation values of the quantum operators required for many algorithms
examples.suggested: قيم التوقع للمؤثرات الكمية المطلوبة لكثير من الخوارزميات
examples.translation: قيم التوقع للمعاملات الكمية المطلوبة لكثير من الخوارزميات
examples.why: معامل standardly means coefficient/parameter; the file itself uses معاملات for "parameters" later, so the defining sentence for Estimator conflates operators with parameters. Recognizable but imperfect.

examples.source: a single circuit-observable pair / multiple circuit-observable pairs
examples.suggested: زوج دائرة-مؤثر واحد / أزواج متعددة من دائرة-مؤثر
examples.translation: زوج Circuit-مراقِب واحد / أزواج متعددة من دائرة-مراقِب
examples.why: Two issues in one phrase: "circuit" alternates between English Circuit and Arabic دائرة across adjacent sections, and مراقِب is the active participle (observer), not the observable being measured.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the Z_f / Z_OR definitions, the three algorithm steps, the "Z_f requires one query while Z_OR requires none" contrast, and the final "(إن وُجد) باحتمالية عالية" caveat all survive intact, and the informal imperative register (هيّئ، طبّق، قِس، اختر، شغّل) is consistent. Nothing misleads, but a native technical editor would change several things. "phase kickback" is calqued as «الركل بالطور» (kicking-with-the-phase) rather than the conventional «ارتداد الطور», which the rest of the ar corpus also uses; "diagram" of a circuit is rendered «الرسم البياني» (= chart/graph) at line 28 but as plain «الرسم»/«رسم» at lines 78/82; and «لقيم أكبر من $t$» reads as "for values greater than t" rather than the source's "for larger values of t", turning the parameter into a threshold. Also «الحالات التعسفية» for "arbitrary states" and «نقرر الاستسلام» for "decide to give up" are stiff calques.

examples.source: For larger values of $t$ we can simply insert additional instances of the Grover operation immediately before the measurements.
examples.suggested: لقيم أكبر لـ$t$، يمكن ببساطة إدراج نسخ إضافية من عملية Grover مباشرة قبل القياسات.
examples.translation: لقيم أكبر من $t$، يمكن ببساطة إدراج نسخ إضافية من عملية Grover مباشرة قبل القياسات.
examples.why: «لقيم أكبر من $t$» is naturally read as 'for values greater than t', recasting t as a threshold; the English means 'for larger values OF t'. The pedagogical point (bigger t ⇒ more Grover blocks) still lands, so this is a garbled qualifier rather than a false claim.

examples.source: This implementation makes use of the phase kickback phenomenon…
examples.suggested: يستخدم هذا التنفيذ ظاهرة ارتداد الطور…
examples.translation: يستخدم هذا التنفيذ ظاهرة الركل بالطور…
examples.why: «الركل بالطور» is a literal calque of 'kick-back' using ركل (to kick). The established Arabic rendering is «ارتداد الطور», which appears elsewhere in the ar corpus — the concept is still recognizable, so this is imperfect-but-identifiable, not a false concept.

examples.source: …as this diagram suggests / In this diagram… / Here's a diagram of a quantum circuit…
examples.suggested: كما يوضح هذا المخطط … في هذا المخطط … هنا مخطط لدائرة كمومية
examples.translation: كما يوضح هذا الرسم البياني … في هذا الرسم … هنا رسم لدائرة كمومية
examples.why: «الرسم البياني» specifically means chart/graph (plotted data), not a circuit diagram; and the term is then rendered two other ways in the same file. «المخطط» / «الرسم التخطيطي» is the right and consistent choice.

examples.source: its behavior on arbitrary states is determined from this expression by linearity
examples.suggested: ويُستنتج سلوكها على أي حالة كيفية من هذه العبارة اعتمادًا على الخطية
examples.translation: ويُستنتج سلوكها على الحالات التعسفية من هذه العبارة بالخطية
examples.why: «تعسفي» carries the sense of arbitrary-as-in-despotic; for mathematical 'arbitrary' a native technical writer uses «اعتباطي/كيفي» or simply «أي حالة». «بالخطية» as a bare instrumental is also stiff.

examples.source: …or we can decide to give up and output "no solution."
examples.suggested: أو نقرر التوقف عن المحاولة وإخراج "لا يوجد حل".
examples.translation: أو نقرر الاستسلام وإخراج "لا يوجد حل".
examples.why: «الاستسلام» (surrender/capitulation) is emotive and out of register for describing an algorithmic termination choice; «التوقف عن المحاولة» or «العدول عن المحاولة» is what a technical writer would use.

editor_note: No hay deriva que engañe al lector en la prosa corrida: la introducción, los cinco encabezados de sección y las descripciones de todas las tarjetas (OBP, SLC, SQD, M3, Pauli propagation) reproducen fielmente el inglés, el registro informal "tú" se mantiene ("Comprende", "Usa", "te ayudan") y "complementos (addons)" es consistente en todo el archivo. Los defectos son de terminología: (1) el título "Optimization mapper" se traduce como "Optimizador de mapeo" (= "mapping optimizer"), invirtiendo la relación núcleo/modificador — el addon mapea problemas de optimización, no optimiza el mapeo — y además rompe el paralelismo con la tarjeta hermana "Fermionic mapper" → "Mapeador fermiónico"; la descripción de la propia tarjeta corrige el sentido, por eso es MINOR y no FAIL. (2) "entangling gates" → "puertas entrelazadas" usa participio pasivo (= "entangled gates") donde corresponde el agentivo "puertas de entrelazamiento". (3) Detalles menores: "transpiler passes" → "pases de transpilación" en lugar de "pasadas/pases del transpilador", y "the SQD addon" pierde el sustantivo ("Una implementación de SQD" en vez de "del complemento SQD"); también la eco "se basan en la base de alto rendimiento" es repetitiva.

examples.source: title="Optimization mapper"
examples.suggested: Mapeador de optimización
examples.translation: title="Optimizador de mapeo"
examples.why: Invierte núcleo y modificador: el addon mapea problemas de optimización, no optimiza el mapeo. Además la tarjeta hermana traduce "Fermionic mapper" como "Mapeador fermiónico", así que el patrón queda inconsistente dentro del mismo CardGroup. La descripción adyacente ("Modela problemas de optimización y mapéalos...") salva el sentido, de ahí que no sea FAIL.

examples.source: Reduce the depth of transpiled circuits by decomposing entangling gates between non-adjacent qubits.
examples.suggested: ...descomponiendo las puertas de entrelazamiento entre qubits no adyacentes.
examples.translation: Reduce la profundidad de los circuitos transpilados descomponiendo las puertas entrelazadas entre qubits no adyacentes.
examples.why: "entangling" es agentivo (puertas que generan entrelazamiento); "puertas entrelazadas" retraduce como "entangled gates", es decir puertas que estarían ellas mismas entrelazadas. El concepto sigue siendo reconocible por el contexto, pero el término convencional en español es "puertas de entrelazamiento" (o "puertas entrelazadoras").

examples.source: ...by incorporating measurement-based postselection transpiler passes.
examples.suggested: ...incorporando pasadas del transpilador de postselección basada en mediciones.
examples.translation: ...incorporando pases de transpilación de postselección basados en mediciones.
examples.why: "transpiler passes" son pasadas/pases DEL transpilador (objetos del pipeline), no "pases de transpilación". Se entiende, pero no es la convención del dominio en la documentación de Qiskit en español.

examples.source: These modular software components build on Qiskit's performant foundation...
examples.suggested: ...se apoyan en los cimientos de alto rendimiento de Qiskit...
examples.translation: Estos componentes modulares de software se basan en la base de alto rendimiento de Qiskit...
examples.why: "se basan en la base" es una repetición léxica que un redactor técnico nativo evitaría; el sentido es correcto, solo suena a traducción.

editor_note: No misleading content: the technical claims (120 qubits en Nighthawk, profundidad transpilada de dos qubits ~30, mínimo de 400 minutos de QPU, 30-120 min por ejecución, ~10× tasas de error de Heron) and the caveats ("estas no son límites rígidos", "no es una computadora de propósito general más rápida") all survive intact, and the informal "tú" holds throughout. What a native editor would still fix: (a) "awards" is rendered "premios" everywhere ("Premios Cuánticos de NSF", "los premios NQISRC", "todos los premios anteriores del programa SBIR") — in the grant domain these are adjudicaciones/concesiones, not prizes; (b) one list item is dropped — EN "upskilling, reskilling, and education" becomes just "capacitación y educación", losing reconversión, which the file itself renders correctly two bullets earlier; (c) "Match agency initiatives" becomes "Alinea las iniciativas de las agencias", i.e. the reader is told to align the agencies' initiatives instead of aligning with them (repeated twice); (d) an agreement error, "Las cálculos de prueba de concepto"; plus calques such as "habilidades de ciberseguridad cuántica segura", "aprendizajes" for apprenticeships, "Sitios web de selección clave" for "Key Curator Websites", and "con referencias completas" for "complete with references".

examples.source: Make sure to include reliable deliverables include benchmarking, comparisons of methods, scaling studies of new algorithms or new approaches, upskilling, reskilling, and education.
examples.suggested: ...nuevos enfoques, capacitación, reconversión laboral y educación.
examples.translation: Asegúrate de incluir entregables confiables que incluyan benchmarking, comparaciones de métodos, estudios de escalado de nuevos algoritmos o nuevos enfoques, capacitación y educación.
examples.why: One deliverable in the list is dropped: EN names three workforce items (upskilling, reskilling, education) and the Spanish collapses them to two, losing 'reskilling'. The same file renders the trio correctly earlier as 'la capacitación, la reconversión y la formación laboral', so this is an internal inconsistency as well as an omission.

examples.source: NSF Quantum Awards ... See NQISRC awards ... all prior awards by Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program
examples.suggested: Adjudicaciones cuánticas de la NSF ... las adjudicaciones NQISRC ... todas las adjudicaciones (concesiones) anteriores del programa SBIR
examples.translation: Premios Cuánticos de NSF ... los premios NQISRC ... todos los premios anteriores del programa Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR)
examples.why: In grant-funding context an 'award' is a funded proposal (adjudicación/concesión), not a prize. 'Premios' reframes competitive funding decisions as honorary awards; recognizable but wrong for a page whose whole subject is applying for funding.

examples.source: Match agency initiatives (both strategic goals and timelines).
examples.suggested: Alinéate con las iniciativas de las agencias (tanto en objetivos estratégicos como en cronogramas).
examples.translation: Alinea las iniciativas de las agencias (tanto los objetivos estratégicos como los cronogramas).
examples.why: The imperative object is inverted: EN tells the applicant to match their own proposal to the agency's initiatives; the Spanish literally instructs the reader to align the agencies' initiatives, something a grant writer cannot do. Repeated identically in both the summary and the detailed list.

examples.source: Proof-of-concept calculations followed by scaling studies are more likely to succeed...
examples.suggested: Los cálculos de prueba de concepto, seguidos de estudios de escalado, tienen más probabilidades de éxito...
examples.translation: Las cálculos de prueba de concepto seguidos de estudios de escalado son más propensos a tener éxito...
examples.why: Gender agreement error ('Las cálculos'), and 'ser propenso a tener éxito' is a calque — 'propenso' carries a negative connotation in Spanish; 'tener más probabilidades de éxito' is what a native technical writer would write.

examples.source: quantum-safe cybersecurity skills ... industry-embedded training and apprenticeships
examples.suggested: habilidades de ciberseguridad resistente a la cuántica ... formación integrada en la industria y programas de aprendizaje (prácticas)
examples.translation: habilidades de ciberseguridad cuántica segura ... formación incorporada en la industria y aprendizajes
examples.why: 'ciberseguridad cuántica segura' is an ambiguous calque that reads as 'secure quantum cybersecurity' rather than 'quantum-safe'; 'aprendizajes' on its own means 'learnings', not apprenticeships, so the workforce-pathway point loses its concrete meaning.

examples.source: ...that can serve as inspiration for your own wording, complete with references.
examples.suggested: ...que pueden servir de inspiración para tu propia redacción, acompañadas de referencias.
examples.translation: ...que pueden servir de inspiración para tu propia redacción, con referencias completas.
examples.why: 'complete with references' means the wording comes accompanied by references; 'con referencias completas' asserts instead that the references themselves are complete — a small unintended claim about the reference list.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, no hallucinated claims; the three plugin types, the `_method` argument rule, the "se prueba en secuencia hasta que uno de ellos tiene éxito" fallback logic, and both "init/translation/optimization" stage sentences all match the English exactly, and informal tú is consistent ("puedes", "Usa", "Consulta", "pásalo"). Terminology is consistent: transpilador, plugin de etapa, síntesis unitaria / de alto nivel, backend, and pass manager → "administrador de pases" (a defensible choice, used uniformly). Two things a native technical editor would still change: "un diccionario de forma libre" is a calque of "free-form dictionary" (Spanish convention is "de formato libre"), and the qualifier in "the wider community of Qiskit users" is dropped to plain "la comunidad de usuarios de Qiskit", losing the sense of reuse beyond the immediate authors. Neither would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Use the `unitary_synthesis_plugin_config` argument, a free-form dictionary, to pass options for the unitary synthesis method.
examples.suggested: Usa el argumento `unitary_synthesis_plugin_config`, un diccionario de formato libre, para pasar opciones al método de síntesis unitaria.
examples.translation: Usa el argumento `unitary_synthesis_plugin_config`, un diccionario de forma libre, para pasar opciones para el método de síntesis unitaria.
examples.why: "de forma libre" is a word-for-word calque of "free-form"; Spanish technical writing says "de formato libre". Also "pasar opciones para el método" is stiffer than "pasar opciones al método".

examples.source: To facilitate the development and reuse of custom transpilation code by the wider community of Qiskit users, the Qiskit SDK supports a plugin interface...
examples.suggested: ...por parte de la comunidad más amplia de usuarios de Qiskit...
examples.translation: Para facilitar el desarrollo y la reutilización de código de transpilación personalizado por parte de la comunidad de usuarios de Qiskit, el SDK de Qiskit admite una interfaz de plugins...
examples.why: "wider" is dropped. The English point is that custom code should be reusable beyond its authors, by the broader user base; the Spanish flattens this to the community in general and loses the motivating nuance of the opening sentence.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat; I checked the delicate passages (the "nothing says Bob must measure his qubit — but nothing says he doesn't" argument, the no-faster-than-light conclusion, the separable/entangled definitions, and the final Tr_A / Tr_B worked example) and they all match the English, and core terminology is correct and consistent (matriz de densidad, traza parcial, estado reducido, estado completamente mezclado, estados producto / separables / entrelazados, qubit, e-bit, aplicación lineal). What a native technical editor would still change is surface polish: "puede afectar posiblemente al estado" (line ~167) is a word-for-word calque of "can possibly influence"; "donde el estado del qubit de Alice se convierte en |0⟩" (lines ~145 and ~152) renders "in which case" as "donde", which reads as a locative rather than a consequence; "medir su qubit en una medición de base estándar" (line ~137) is stiff; and "subindice" (line ~282) is missing its accent and is inconsistent with the correct "subíndice" at line ~181. The opening "Ahora nos dirigimos a la cuestión de cómo funcionan" is translationese for "turn our attention to". Register is correctly informal/"nosotros" throughout with no usted slips; "se traza fuera" for "traced out" is a calque but is used consistently and is recognizable, so I did not count it.

examples.source: And if he's light years away, then nothing he does or doesn't do can possibly influence the state of Alice's qubit viewed it in isolation.
examples.suggested: Y si está a años luz de distancia, nada de lo que haga o deje de hacer puede afectar en modo alguno al estado del qubit de Alice considerado en aislamiento.
examples.translation: Y si está a años luz de distancia, nada de lo que haga o deje de hacer puede afectar posiblemente al estado del qubit de Alice en aislamiento.
examples.why: "puede afectar posiblemente" is a literal transfer of "can possibly influence"; in Spanish the emphatic negation is carried by "en modo alguno"/"de ninguna manera", not by an adverbial "posiblemente", which here reads as hedging rather than reinforcing.

examples.source: in which case the state of Alice's qubit becomes |0⟩; and he would obtain the outcome 1 with probability
examples.suggested: en cuyo caso el estado del qubit de Alice pasa a ser |0⟩; y obtendría el resultado 1 con probabilidad
examples.translation: donde el estado del qubit de Alice se convierte en |0⟩; y obtendría el resultado 1 con probabilidad
examples.why: "donde" reads as a locative relative to the preceding displayed formula instead of marking the consequence of the measurement outcome; "en cuyo caso" is the standard connector and keeps the conditional structure of the argument explicit. Same slip repeats a few lines later for the outcome 1.

examples.source: we can put the names of whatever systems we choose in the subscript of a density matrix
examples.suggested: podemos poner en el subíndice de una matriz de densidad los nombres de los sistemas que queramos
examples.translation: podemos indicar los nombres de cualesquiera sistemas en el subindice de una matriz de densidad
examples.why: "subindice" is missing its accent ("subíndice") and contradicts the correctly accented "subíndice" used at line ~181; "cualesquiera sistemas" is also stiffer than the plain English "whatever systems we choose".

examples.source: if Bob decided somewhere on his journey to measure his qubit with respect to a standard basis measurement
examples.suggested: si Bob decidiera, en algún punto de su viaje, medir su qubit mediante una medición de base estándar
examples.translation: si Bob decidiera, en algún punto de su viaje, medir su qubit en una medición de base estándar
examples.why: "medir ... en una medición" is an awkward preposition choice that collides with the repeated noun; "mediante/con una medición de base estándar" is what a Spanish-writing physicist would use.

examples.source: Now we'll turn our attention to how density matrices work for multiple systems
examples.suggested: Ahora centraremos nuestra atención en cómo funcionan las matrices de densidad para sistemas múltiples
examples.translation: Ahora nos dirigimos a la cuestión de cómo funcionan las matrices de densidad para sistemas múltiples
examples.why: "nos dirigimos a la cuestión de" is a calqued rendering of "turn our attention to"; the idiomatic Spanish opener for a lesson is "centraremos nuestra atención en" / "pasamos ahora a ver".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every number, condition and caveat survives (resto de 1 / valor 25, "este NO es el tiempo usado para la facturación", "no pueden resolverse a valores de delay negativos", "El solucionador actual no infiere restricciones de no negatividad"), and the tú register holds consistently (puedes, Ten en cuenta, debes, Usa, consulta). Three small things a native technical editor would still fix, none of them misleading: (1) "Puedes interpretar el segundo y tercer stretches" is an agreement slip — Spanish needs "el segundo y el tercer stretch" (or "los stretches segundo y tercero"); (2) in "primero debes establecer una opción experimental para habilitarlo", the clitic "lo" loses the source's specific antecedent ("enable its retrieval" — the retrieval of the stretch values), so it can be misread as enabling stretch support itself; (3) "mientras otro qubit realiza operaciones condicionales" makes the idle qubit's neighbour the agent, whereas the English "is undergoing conditional operations" has the operations applied TO it. Terminology is correct and consistent: stretch/delay kept in English as API/type names, puertas for gates, qubit, barreras/región de barrera, temporización for timing, planificado for scheduled.

examples.source: You can interpret the second and third stretches similarly.
examples.suggested: Puedes interpretar el segundo y el tercer stretch de manera similar.
examples.translation: Puedes interpretar el segundo y tercer stretches de manera similar.
examples.why: In Spanish an ordinal chain governs a singular noun ('el segundo y el tercer stretch'); 'el segundo y tercer stretches' mixes a singular determiner/ordinal with a plural noun and reads as an English carry-over.

examples.source: Support for `stretch` in Qiskit Runtime is currently experimental, so you need to first set an experimental option to enable its retrieval, then access the data directly from the metadata as follows:
examples.suggested: ... por lo que primero debes establecer una opción experimental para habilitar su recuperación, y luego acceder a los datos directamente desde los metadatos de la siguiente manera:
examples.translation: El soporte de `stretch` en Qiskit Runtime es actualmente experimental, por lo que primero debes establecer una opción experimental para habilitarlo, y luego acceder a los datos directamente desde los metadatos de la siguiente manera:
examples.why: 'para habilitarlo' drops the qualifier 'retrieval': the option enables retrieval of the resolved stretch values, not stretch support itself. The following clause keeps the reader on track, so it does not mislead, but the qualifier should be restored.

examples.source: A common use case of `stretch` is to apply dynamical decoupling to an idling qubit while another qubit is undergoing conditional operations.
examples.suggested: ... mientras se aplican operaciones condicionales a otro qubit.
examples.translation: Un caso de uso común de `stretch` es aplicar desacoplamiento dinámico a un qubit inactivo mientras otro qubit realiza operaciones condicionales.
examples.why: 'realiza' turns the second qubit into the agent performing the operations; the English has it as the target of conditional operations. The circuit example makes the intent clear, so this is a nuance loss rather than a misleading statement.

editor_note: One genuine semantic inversion: in the 9-qubit Shor code section the English "except that $X\otimes X\otimes X$ is substituted for $X$" (i.e. XXX takes the place of each single X) is rendered as "excepto que $X\otimes X\otimes X$ se sustituye por $X$", which in Spanish means the opposite — that XXX is replaced by X. A learner would conclude the last two generators carry single X factors, contradicting the block of six X's displayed immediately above, so the whole construction of the phase-flip generators is taught backwards. Secondary (non-misleading) issues: a clear two-pass split in core terminology — "generadores del estabilizador" through §Dimensión vs "generadores estabilizadores" from §Detección de errores onward, "espacio del código" (first half) vs "espacio de código" (second half), and "código Steane de 7 qubits" vs "código de Steane de 7 qubits"; plus two calques, "toman una forma reminiscente del circuito" (natural Spanish would be "que recuerda al circuito") and "no podemos posiblemente corregir todos los errores" (a literal rendering of "can't possibly"; native usage is "no hay forma de corregir…"). Register is consistently informal tú ("Ten en cuenta", "supón", "considera") and the rest of the proof prose is faithful.

examples.source: they take the same form as for the 3-bit repetition code for phase flips, except that $X\otimes X\otimes X$ is substituted for $X,$
examples.suggested: toman la misma forma que en el código de repetición de 3 bits para cambios de fase, excepto que cada $X$ se sustituye por $X\otimes X\otimes X$
examples.translation: toman la misma forma que en el código de repetición de 3 bits para cambios de fase, excepto que $X\otimes X\otimes X$ se sustituye por $X$
examples.why: Direction of the substitution is inverted: 'A is substituted for B' = A replaces B, but 'A se sustituye por B' = A is replaced by B. The Spanish tells the learner the XXX blocks collapse to a single X, the reverse of how the Shor-code generators are built, and it contradicts the generator list shown just above.

examples.source: stabilizer generators
examples.suggested: use 'generadores del estabilizador' throughout (it matches 'elemento del estabilizador', used consistently in both halves)
examples.translation: 'generadores del estabilizador' (§Definición … §Dimensión del espacio del código) vs 'generadores estabilizadores' (§Detección de errores … end)
examples.why: Same core term rendered two ways with a clean break at the file midpoint — the classic two-pass-merge split. Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but a native editor would unify it. The same break affects 'espacio del código' → 'espacio de código' (line 40 vs 405) and 'código Steane' → 'código de Steane' (line 195 vs 420).

examples.source: which take a form reminiscent of the circuit for detecting phase flips for this code
examples.suggested: cuya forma recuerda a la del circuito para detectar cambios de fase en este código
examples.translation: que toman una forma reminiscente del circuito para detectar cambios de fase en este código
examples.why: 'reminiscente' is a rare Latinism in Spanish and reads as a direct calque of 'reminiscent'; a Spanish-speaking technical writer would use 'recuerda a' / 'evoca'.

examples.source: we can't possibly correct every error detected by a stabilizer code
examples.suggested: no hay forma de corregir todos los errores detectados por un código estabilizador
examples.translation: no podemos posiblemente corregir todos los errores detectados por un código estabilizador
examples.why: 'no podemos posiblemente' is a word-for-word calque of 'can't possibly' and is not idiomatic Spanish; the adverb does not carry the emphatic sense it has in English.

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout: the "menor de estos valores" / "se utiliza el menor de los dos valores" comparisons, the 5000 s vs 300 s example, the 3-hour cap, the 50 MB input limit and the "10 minutos en una QPU por ventana continua de 28 días" all match the source exactly; TTL/batch/session semantics (running jobs continue, queued jobs "pasan a un estado de error") are preserved, terminology is consistent (batch, TTL máximo/interactivo, tiempo de espera del trabajo, uso de la QPU), and the informal tú register holds ("puedes", "Consulta", "Establece", "Revisa").

Second bullet inserts a qualifier the English does not have: "the state of one system that happens to be entangled with another system" becomes "el estado de un sistema que está *aleatoriamente* entrelazado con otro sistema". "Happens to be" is the idiomatic "resulta estar / da la casualidad de que está" — it marks an incidental circumstance, not randomness — whereas "aleatoriamente entrelazado" asserts *random* entanglement, narrowing the general motivation for reduced density matrices to an imagined special case, and it collides with the genuinely random notion in the preceding bullet ("estados cuánticos elegidos aleatoriamente"), so a learner is invited to read the two as the same phenomenon. Two smaller slips: in the opening sentence the parallel "represented ... represented" is broken ("los estados cuánticos se representan ... las operaciones se describen mediante matrices unitarias"), and "a critically important aspect" is calqued as "un aspecto fundamentalmente importante" where a native writer would say "de importancia fundamental" / "de una importancia crítica". Register (tú: "completa", "puedes abrir", "te guía") and core terminology (matrices de densidad, valores propios, aplicaciones lineales, matrices unitarias/estocásticas, entrelazado) are correct and consistent.

examples.source: Density matrices allow us to describe states of isolated parts of systems, such as the state of one system that happens to be entangled with another system that we wish to ignore.
examples.suggested: ... por ejemplo, el estado de un sistema que resulta estar entrelazado con otro sistema que deseamos ignorar.
examples.translation: Las matrices de densidad nos permiten describir estados de partes aisladas de sistemas, por ejemplo, el estado de un sistema que está aleatoriamente entrelazado con otro sistema que deseamos ignorar.
examples.why: "Happens to be entangled" expresses an incidental fact, not randomness. "Aleatoriamente entrelazado" adds a claim absent from the source and restricts the motivation for density matrices to *random* entanglement; combined with the previous bullet's "estados cuánticos elegidos aleatoriamente", the learner can conclude that reduced states are only needed for randomly generated entanglement, which is false.

examples.source: quantum states are represented by quantum state vectors, operations are represented by unitary matrices
examples.suggested: los estados cuánticos se representan mediante vectores de estado cuántico, las operaciones se representan mediante matrices unitarias
examples.translation: los estados cuánticos se representan mediante vectores de estado cuántico, las operaciones se describen mediante matrices unitarias
examples.why: The English deliberately repeats "represented" to set up the later contrast (matrices normally represent operations, yet density matrices represent states). Switching the second verb to "se describen" breaks that parallel and weakens the setup for the paragraph at line 38-39.

examples.source: the fact that density matrices can (like all matrices) be associated with linear mappings is a critically important aspect of them
examples.suggested: ... es un aspecto de importancia fundamental / de una importancia crítica
examples.translation: el hecho de que las matrices de densidad (como todas las matrices) puedan asociarse con aplicaciones lineales es un aspecto fundamentalmente importante de ellas
examples.why: "Fundamentalmente importante" is a calque of the English adverb+adjective pattern; Spanish technical prose uses the nominal construction "de importancia fundamental". The trailing "de ellas" is also redundant and stiff.

editor_note: Nothing in this page would mislead a learner: every option description, the `min_qpy_version` rejection rule ("rechazará archivos con una versión de QPY inferior a la definida aquí"), and the `QISKIT_SABRE_ALL_THREADS` tradeoff ("los resultados no son reproducibles al ejecutarse en hardware local diferente") match the English, and the informal "tú" register holds throughout ("puedes", "Establece", "si quieres contribuir"). Three small things a native technical editor would still change. (1) In `QISKIT_FORCE_THREADS`, "to avoid potentially overloading limited CPU resources" becomes "para evitar sobrecargar los recursos de CPU disponibles" — the hedge "potentially" is dropped and "limited" is turned into its near-opposite framing "disponibles", losing the reason the serial fallback exists. (2) "sobreescribirse" is used twice (lines 29, 38/39) where the RAE-correct form is "sobrescribirse". (3) "evitando así la carga de cargas útiles potencialmente maliciosas" stacks "carga/cargas" awkwardly; "impidiendo así cargar contenidos potencialmente maliciosos" reads like native technical prose.

examples.source: This is done to avoid potentially overloading limited CPU resources.
examples.suggested: Esto se hace para evitar una posible sobrecarga de los limitados recursos de CPU.
examples.translation: Esto se hace para evitar sobrecargar los recursos de CPU disponibles.
examples.why: Drops the hedge "potentially" and reframes "limited" as "disponibles" (available), weakening the stated rationale for running the function serially. Not misleading enough to teach a false concept, but a dropped qualifier a native editor would restore.

examples.source: preventing the loading of potentially malicious payloads
examples.suggested: impidiendo así cargar contenidos potencialmente maliciosos
examples.translation: evitando así la carga de cargas útiles potencialmente maliciosas
examples.why: "la carga de cargas útiles" repeats the same root twice in five words; a Spanish technical writer would avoid the echo. "Carga útil" is a defensible rendering of payload, but the collocation here is clumsy.

examples.source: the path can be overridden with the QISKIT_SETTINGS environment variable
examples.suggested: la ruta puede sobrescribirse con la variable de entorno `QISKIT_SETTINGS`
examples.translation: la ruta puede sobreescribirse con la variable de entorno `QISKIT_SETTINGS`
examples.why: "sobreescribirse" (three times in the file) is a common misspelling; the standard form is "sobrescribir". Purely orthographic — meaning is clear.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift, inverted condition, swapped quantity or hallucinated claim; the delicate passages (the betas-too-small explanation at "las betas eran demasiado pequeñas para penalizar el autoestado mínimo", the Step-4 convergence caveat, and the long "no es posible que un cálculo variacional produzca una energía inferior a la verdadera energía del estado fundamental" argument in the last 40%) all land exactly as in English, and the informal "tú" register holds consistently ("Ten en cuenta", "Recuerda", "Intenta explicar", "te mantendrá alejado"). The defects are consistency and polish only. Three core terms are rendered two or three ways within the same file: "eigenvalue/eigenstate" is "valor propio / estado propio" in the VQE half (lines ~20, 26, 32, 45, 266, 1192, 1416) but switches to "autovalor / autoestado" for the whole VQD half (lines ~391, 441, 454, 669, 675, 785, 787); "gate" is "puerta Hadamard" (line ~233) but "compuerta $Z$" (line ~1231); and "quantum computer" appears as "ordenador cuántico" (line ~790), "computador cuántico" (line ~1063) and "computadora cuántica" (lines ~1192, 1219) — the ~790 and ~1063 cases translate the *identical* English sentence differently. Also "pass manager" is "gestor de pases preconfigurado" (line ~809) but left as "pass manager preconfigurado" (line ~1075); there is an orthographic typo "Como se menciónó" (line ~669); and "or are off by a few percent" is calqued as "o nos desviamos unos pocos porcentajes" (line ~1151), which a native technical writer would not write.

examples.source: How to apply a variational algorithm to find minimum eigenvalues … we will look for all 4
examples.suggested: Pick one convention for the whole file — e.g. «valor propio / estado propio» everywhere (or «autovalor / autoestado» everywhere)
examples.translation: …encontrar valores propios mínimos … buscaremos los 4 autovalores (implícito: «el autovalor más bajo»)
examples.why: The file splits eigenvalue/eigenstate into two synonym families along a section boundary: «valor propio»/«estado propio» in the VQE and max-cut sections, «autovalor»/«autoestado» throughout the VQD sections (lines ~391, 441, 454, 669, 675, 785, 787). Both are correct Spanish and the concept stays identifiable, so this is not misleading, but a learner reading straight through may briefly wonder whether two different quantities are meant.

examples.source: To run this on real hardware, we must optimize the quantum circuits for our quantum computer of choice.
examples.suggested: Use the same rendering in both places (e.g. «computadora cuántica», which the file already uses at lines ~1192 and ~1219)
examples.translation: …para el ordenador cuántico que hayamos elegido. (l. 790) / …para el computador cuántico de nuestra elección. (l. 1063)
examples.why: This is the exact same English sentence translated twice, and it comes out with two different words for «quantum computer», while a third variant («computadora cuántica») is used in the max-cut section. Three regional variants of one core term inside one lesson is a consistency defect a native editor would unify.

examples.source: it seems reasonable to use a Hadamard gate as a reference circuit … the variable z_i will be equivalent to a Z gate acting on qubit i
examples.suggested: Use «puerta» in both places (or «compuerta» in both)
examples.translation: …usar una puerta Hadamard como circuito de referencia … la variable z_i será equivalente a una compuerta Z actuando sobre el qubit i
examples.why: «gate» is rendered «puerta» in the reference-state section and «compuerta» in the max-cut section. Both are standard, but mixing them within a single lesson is the kind of inconsistency that makes the text feel machine-assembled.

examples.source: If we fail to obtain an accurate ground state energy (or are off by a few percent), then we also fail to obtain an accurate ground state vector!
examples.suggested: …(o nos desviamos en un pequeño porcentaje), entonces tampoco obtenemos un vector preciso del estado fundamental.
examples.translation: Si no logramos obtener una energía precisa del estado fundamental (o nos desviamos unos pocos porcentajes), ¡también fallamos en obtener un vector preciso del estado fundamental!
examples.why: «nos desviamos unos pocos porcentajes» is a literal calque of «off by a few percent»; in Spanish one deviates *by* a percentage («en un pequeño porcentaje», «en unos pocos puntos porcentuales»), not «unos pocos porcentajes». «fallamos en obtener» is likewise an English-shaped construction where «tampoco obtenemos» is natural.

examples.source: We will transpile our circuit using a preset pass manager … We will use a preset pass manager for transpilation
examples.suggested: Settle on one: either translate it («gestor de pases») or keep the API-facing English term («pass manager») in both spots
examples.translation: …usando un gestor de pases preconfigurado… (l. 809) / Usaremos un pass manager preconfigurado para la transpilación… (l. 1075)
examples.why: The same Qiskit concept is translated in one section and left in English in another; since it maps to the API call generate_preset_pass_manager, either choice is defensible but the split is not.

examples.source: As mentioned in the previous lesson, the values of β should be bigger than the difference between eigenvalues.
examples.suggested: Como se mencionó en la lección anterior, …
examples.translation: Como se menciónó en la lección anterior, los valores de β deben ser mayores que la diferencia entre autovalores.
examples.why: Orthographic typo: «menciónó» carries a spurious accent on the stem; the correct form is «mencionó». Purely cosmetic but visible in body prose.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, caveat and example (the `ml`/`chemlab` substring trap, the `MLreader`/`MLwriter` split, "une instance de service ne peut appartenir qu'à un seul groupe de ressources", the Terraform allocation/limit note) matches the English exactly, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout with no vous/veuillez slips. What a native technical editor would still change are three calques: "C'est une fonction du fonctionnement d'IAM" (word-for-word "This is a function of how IAM works", where French idiom is "Cela découle du fonctionnement d'IAM"), "Cette méthode peut accommoder une structure hiérarchique" (anglicism for "accommodate"; French "peut prendre en charge / s'adapter à"), and "génériques à IBM Cloud" (calque of "generic to"). Terminology is otherwise correct and consistent — "instance de service", "groupe d'accès", "groupe de ressources", "mappage", and backends/jobs sensibly kept in English. None of these mislead a learner.

examples.source: This is a function of how IAM works and cannot be changed.
examples.suggested: Cela découle du fonctionnement d'IAM et ne peut pas être modifié.
examples.translation: C'est une fonction du fonctionnement d'IAM et ne peut pas être modifiée.
examples.why: Word-for-word calque; "une fonction du fonctionnement" is not French idiom and the repetition of fonction/fonctionnement reads as machine output. Meaning is preserved, so this is cosmetic only.

examples.source: This method can accommodate a hierarchical structure.
examples.suggested: Cette méthode peut prendre en charge une structure hiérarchique.
examples.translation: Cette méthode peut accommoder une structure hiérarchique.
examples.why: "Accommoder" is a false friend in this sense (in French it means to adapt/season, not to support); a native technical writer would use "prendre en charge" or "s'adapter à".

examples.source: most of the steps in this guide are generic to IBM Cloud and not specific to IBM Quantum Platform
examples.suggested: la plupart des étapes de ce guide sont génériques à IBM Cloud (et non propres à IBM Quantum Platform)
examples.translation: la plupart des étapes de ce guide sont génériques à IBM Cloud et non spécifiques à IBM Quantum Platform
examples.why: "Génériques à" is a calque of "generic to"; French takes "génériques pour" or a rephrasing. Understandable, but stiff.

editor_note: Semantically faithful end to end — I checked the whole anti-commutation argument, the +1/-1 syndrome table paragraph, the 8-dim → four 2-dim subspace split, the "exactly 16 of the 64 Pauli operations" count and the closing logical-X paragraph, and none of them drift, soften or invent anything; core terminology is correct and consistent (stabilizer generators → "générateurs du stabilisateur", code space → "espace du code", bit-flip → "retournement de bit", vecteur propre / valeur propre, non destructive → "non destructive"). What a native technical editor would still change is surface French: line 115 "ainsi qu'aucune erreur du tout" is ungrammatical as written (needs "ainsi que pour l'absence d'erreur"); line 140 "pour cet observable" uses the wrong gender — in French physics "observable" is feminine ("cette observable"), and the file elsewhere only ever uses gender-neutral forms so this is the single slip. Three further calques read as English syntax carried over: "le résultat est donc certain d'être celui..." (line 84, from "is certain to be"), sentence-initial "Parce que X et Z anticommutent, ... il s'ensuit que" (line 71, where "Comme"/"Étant donné que" is the native construction), and the echo "vérifier qu'il s'agit d'un encodage valide en vérifiant les deux équations" (line 20) plus "et en effet l'effet de cette opération" (line 153). None of these would mislead a learner; they are polish items only.

examples.source: The table only includes columns for the errors corresponding to a single bit-flip, as well as no error at all, which is described by the identity tensored with itself three times.
examples.suggested: Le tableau ne comprend des colonnes que pour les erreurs correspondant à un seul retournement de bit, ainsi que pour l'absence totale d'erreur, décrite par l'identité tensorisée trois fois avec elle-même.
examples.translation: Le tableau ne comprend des colonnes que pour les erreurs correspondant à un seul retournement de bit, ainsi qu'aucune erreur du tout, ce qui est décrit par l'identité tensorisée avec elle-même trois fois.
examples.why: "ainsi qu'aucune erreur du tout" is not grammatical French — the coordinated element after "ne ... que pour les erreurs" has to repeat the preposition and cannot be a bare negative NP. Meaning is still recoverable, so it is a polish defect, not a misleading one.

examples.source: namely the space of $+1$ eigenvectors and the space of $-1$ eigenvectors for that observable
examples.suggested: ... pour cette observable
examples.translation: à savoir l'espace des vecteurs propres $+1$ et l'espace des vecteurs propres $-1$ pour cet observable
examples.why: In French quantum-mechanics usage "observable" is a feminine noun ("une observable", "cette observable"). This is the only place in the file where the gender surfaces, so the error is isolated but a native editor would fix it on sight.

examples.source: the outcome is therefore certain to be the one associated with the eigenvalue $-1.$
examples.suggested: le résultat sera donc à coup sûr celui associé à la valeur propre $-1.$
examples.translation: le résultat est donc certain d'être celui associé à la valeur propre $-1.$
examples.why: "être certain de" applied to an inanimate subject is a direct calque of English "is certain to be"; in French only an animate subject "est certain de". A French-speaking physicist would write "sera à coup sûr" or "est nécessairement".

examples.source: Because $X$ and $Z$ anti-commute, whereas every matrix commutes with the identity matrix, it follows that ...
examples.suggested: Comme $X$ et $Z$ anticommutent, alors que toute matrice commute avec la matrice identité, il s'ensuit que ...
examples.translation: Parce que $X$ et $Z$ anticommutent, alors que toute matrice commute avec la matrice identité, il s'ensuit que ...
examples.why: Sentence-initial "Parce que" is a translationese calque of "Because"; French technical prose opens a causal clause with "Comme" or "Étant donné que". Grammatical but audibly machine-translated.

examples.source: we could verify that we have a valid encoding by checking the following two equations / and indeed the effect of this operation on an encoding is ...
examples.suggested: on pourrait s'assurer qu'il s'agit d'un encodage valide en contrôlant les deux équations suivantes / et de fait, l'effet de cette opération sur un encodage est ...
examples.translation: on pourrait vérifier qu'il s'agit d'un encodage valide en vérifiant les deux équations suivantes / et en effet l'effet de cette opération sur un encodage est ...
examples.why: Two avoidable echoes: "vérifier ... en vérifiant" repeats the same verb in one clause, and "en effet l'effet" stacks near-homophones. Both are stylistic only, but a native editor would break them up.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantitative claim (156 qubits, ~10 iterations vs ~100 for variational, 10x fewer entangling gates than DQA, 3-4x fewer than QAOA, AR=100% = ground state, `seed_transpiler=None` behavior, `direct_qubit_mapping=True` on `ibm_marrakesh`) is transferred correctly, the benchmark table is intact, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout. What a native technical editor would change is terminology and idiom: "entangling gates" is rendered "portes enchevêtrantes" (the field standard is "portes d'intrication" / "portes intriquantes" — "enchevêtré" means tangled/jumbled), and bit-flipping is split within one paragraph between "les bits ... sont retournés" / "retournements de bits locaux" and the hybrid "erreurs de flip de bit". There are also two false-friend/calque slips — "la différence ... peut être dramatique" (EN "dramatic" = "spectaculaire/considérable"; FR "dramatique" means tragic) and "mappe le bitstring de solution en retour vers les nœuds" for "map back" — plus the stilted "Pour du soutien, contacte support@...". Finally the closing trivia reads "il y a 2000 ans avant J.-C.", which mixes "2000 years ago" with "BCE"; the era and figure survive but the phrase is self-contradictory.

examples.source: quantum circuits with shorter depth and fewer entangling gates … up to ten times fewer entangling gates than DQA
examples.suggested: … avec moins de portes d'intrication … dix fois moins de portes d'intrication que DQA
examples.translation: circuits quantiques de moindre profondeur avec moins de portes enchevêtrantes … jusqu'à dix fois moins de portes enchevêtrantes que DQA
examples.why: French quantum-computing usage is « intrication » for entanglement; « enchevêtré » means tangled/jumbled and reads as a literal mis-rendering of the domain term, though a reader would still identify the concept.

examples.source: Since the post-processing corrects local bitflips, it compensates for bit-flip errors that often are the result of hardware imperfections
examples.suggested: … corrige les inversions de bits locales, il compense les erreurs d'inversion de bit …
